verdict.rationale: Algolia stores a copy of your data in indices (algolia-docs-54), and the Search API and CLI let you manage indices and records (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-50), which implies you can remove records you send. Nothing in the pack explicitly documents deletion or any retention controls, and Agent Studio caches completions by default with no documented way to control that cache (algolia-docs-24). Missing for 10: explicit record/index deletion docs, configurable retention periods for analytics/logs/cached completions, account-level data deletion or GDPR erasure workflows, independent corroboration.
